10. TCP vs UDP

TCP provides a reliable ordered byte stream; UDP sends datagrams without built-in delivery,
ordering or retransmission guarantees.
TCP එක bytes පිළිJවළට සහ විශ්වාසදොයකව ලබාJදෙනවා. UDP එක datagrams යවනවා; delivery
සහ order guarantee එක protocol එJකන්ම නැහැ.
File downloads often use TCP; real-time traffic may use UDP or QUIC.

Q: Is UDP always faster than TCP?
A: No. UDP has less built-in transport machinery, but performance depends on the application and
network.
